caption:
Korean Rice Noodles 
30 minute dinners | easy meal prep 

Nutrition: 
C: 55 | F: 9 | P: 37
Calories: 408 per serve (considering 3 serves)
Serves 3 or 4 portions depending on you! 

Ingredients
1/2  tsp chilli oil, more mix less oil 
4-5 cloves, chopped garlic 
1 onion, chopped
200 grams button mushroom
1 green capsicum, cubed
1 tbsp heaping gochujang or any chilli paste you have available *homemade option mentioned below 
1 tbsp gochugara or any chilli flakes
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp vinegar 
450 grams chicken mince | for a veg option, use crumbled tofu
1 tbsp black pepper
120 grams rice noodles or any of your prefered noodles 

method
add chilli oil to a pan 
follow that up with the garlic and onions and allow to cook for a few minutes
add in the mushroom and let it cook till the water evaporates, then add in the green capsicum and combine 
add in the gochujang + gochugara + soy sauce + vinegar along with 1 ladel of the rice noodle water
add in the chicken mince and stir to combine 
add in the black pepper and let the mince cook
once it is ready, add in your cooked rice noodles or any noodle you prefer to use and a few ladels of the water and mix together
top with your gochugara and any fresh herbs you have if you like 
enjoy it well :)

pro tip: 
you can use any veges you like for this
for homemade chilli paste, blend together soaked kashmiri red chillis + garlic and use and it can be stored in the fridge for 2-3 weeks 
wanna make it veg? use crumbled tofu <3
